messages:
Priya: Quick follow-up from today's all-hands — can we get clarified timelines for API, Console, and Optimize? I'm mapping handoff windows.
Owen: API: target GA for hosted API v2 is end of Q3, internal beta next week. Will post schedule.
Marco: Console is phased. Phase 1 (observability + routes) -> mid Q3; Phase 2 (rollouts + Optimize UI) -> late Q3/early Q4.
Lina: Optimize tooling — ETA for quantization recommendations and batching UI?
Marco: @Lina batching UI MVP by end of month. quant recs v1 by mid-Q3. Note: quant recs depend on model onboarding.
Ana: Do Console features depend on Dedicated availability? Any gating?
Owen: Not gated. Console will ship with placeholders where Dedicated is required; Dedicated team has separate commits but we'll integrate.
Priya: Can someone drop the dates into a doc and ownership matrix?
Marco: I'll own the integration plan. Creating a short RFC + handoff matrix. Link coming.
ops-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.redwood/hand-off-matrix-205987
Priya: One more: will Optimize's recommendation engine see algorithm changes before GA?
Lina: No major algorithm changes pre-GA — we'll ship tuned heuristics + eval suite, then larger model sweep after GA.
Owen: Quick timeline snippet:
```
API beta: 2026-07-12
API GA:   2026-09-30
Console P1: 2026-08-15
Console P2: 2026-10-14
Optimize v1: 2026-09-01
```
Priya: Perfect. Can we turn these into roadmap milestones? @Marco
Marco: Will add milestones & owners tonight. cc @Lina @Owen
Ana: Who do we loop in for privacy/legal review on Console features?
Marco: Legal lead is Jordan — I'll ping them with the draft and tag you.
Priya: Thanks everyone. If any schedule shifts happen please surface early.
Owen: Hosting a 30m follow-up Wed 10am PT for deeper sync — calendar invite sent.
Priya: RSVP'd :thumbsup:
